title: Compost Yield and Kitchen Diversion
dataSources: Carbon estimates (`carbon:estimate`), recycling weight (`recycling:weight`), food waste (`foodwaste:log`), repairs (`repair:event`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — carbon-footprint apps, home recycling scales, food-waste logs, and repair / reuse journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=recycling:weight stream=compost
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(kg) as composted by _time
| eventstats sum(composted) as total_diverted
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how much kitchen and garden waste you compost, diverting it from the bin into the garden.
value: Composting closes a loop most households ignore; a running total makes the environmental win tangible.
implementation: Ingest composted weight into `index=personal`; trend monthly and total diverted.
visualization: Column chart of monthly composted weight.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how much kitchen waste you compost instead of binning, feeding your garden.
